holds.reason: Version 0.7.0 of collections removes Option, Some, None, Ok, Err and Result, and 0.10.0 removes 83 more names. @procedures/collections exports these names from its root. Thus the update is a breaking change of the client group, and it ships as its own MINOR after a release that marks the names deprecated.

The next version of rational, 0.1.3, ships in the npm sitting of 2026-11-21 with the other packages of its repository (roadmap A17 of algebra). Its only change on main since 0.1.2 is a test helper and a new dev dependency (rigor-generators), so the code of the package does not change.
